sources.finding: Older indexed text says 409 x10 and omits carrier-cancel values; retained only to explain version skew.

contract_snapshot.version_skew_policy: Preserve raw values, avoid irreversible effects for unknown values, and make S04 independently reproduce the current official page.

capabilities.finding: POST /api/v3/orders/status is the current FBS pull endpoint.
Marketplace token in Authorization header; no credential operations performed.
Required orders array contains 1..1000 int64 assembly-order IDs. The visible schema does not claim uniqueness; caller-side uniqueness is a local invariant.
200 response returns orders rows with id, supplierStatus and wbStatus.
Current official enum includes postponed_delivery plus carrier values; documented sandbox transitions show why sorted must remain polled, but were not executed.
Maximum 1000 IDs per status request; caller shards larger sets.
Status endpoint has no pagination token; batching is the applicable mechanism.

300/minute, 200 ms and burst 20. Older indexed official text says precisely 409 x10; current live-visible text broadens accounting to every 4XX x10. Current budget uses the broader rule and S15 must cover 409 x10 explicitly.
Current status endpoint documents 200, 400, 401, 402, 403 and 429. A 404 is an unexpected-response emulator case, not a documented status response.
No partial-success contract is documented; success is evaluated per returned matching ID.
Retry constraints and current batch-to-single amplification risk are documented; exact retry policy belongs to S13.
Researched FBS contract specifies pull polling and no webhook; S04 must independently challenge this absence.
Official sandbox status transitions are test designs with evidence_state=documented_not_executed; no sandbox token, API execution or emulator proof exists in S03.
WB limit is per seller account and local processing is tenant/seller scoped.
Starvation, request amplification, restart safety and rate-budget constraints are documented.

Explicit runnable S15 coverage is enumerated for complete/partial/malformed 200, missing/duplicate/foreign IDs, unknown and late statuses, carrier values, 400/401/402/403/404/409/429, current 4XX x10 accounting, timeout/5XX, fallback cap, restart/replay and starvation.
Order last_wb_sync_at exists but is not updated by status reconciliation; success semantics are specified for Product/Architecture.
These domains are outside the touched status-read contract; only status-triggered side effects are handed to Product/Architecture.
Narrow research of an existing external call does not add a new operator workflow or domain.
